summary: Turn counter observations into testable kernel hypotheses without treating every stall label as a root cause.
outcomes: Relate requested, transferred and reused bytes to arithmetic intensity.
Select useful counters and test an instruction or memory bottleneck.
sequence: Predict operations and bytes for a small kernel.
Inspect launch configuration and relevant counter groups.
Relate stalls, issue activity and memory transactions to source.
Explain replay, cache control and collection overhead.
Change one factor and compare correctness and performance.

visual.question: Which source access explains these extra memory transactions?
visual.interaction: Select accesses and compare a predicted transaction diagram with measured counters.

practice.task: Diagnose a strided kernel and a register-heavy kernel.
practice.success: Each diagnosis uses multiple consistent observations and a successful or falsified experiment.
